title: Users
intro: Members of {organization}. Administrators manage the prompts, the invitations, the shared mailboxes and the organisation's settings. They have no access to a member's personal mailbox.
linkReady: Invitation link for {email} — valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, usable once. Pass it on yourself: it will not be shown again.
copyFailed: Could not copy: select the link and copy it.
confirmDelete: Delete the account {email}? Its connected mailboxes, emails and replies stored here will be erased. The mailbox itself is not touched.
